title: Djinns and Djinn Seals
text: Djinns are sleeping spirit-beings you bind with their Seal. Seals come from floor bosses, vault chests, trading, Dark Rukh Shards and admin grants, and clearing a pocket rift has a 6% chance (rift.djinnSealChance) to give a Seal to a random player inside. The status menu shows your Djinn, its phase and trust. Djinn weapons are 3D weapons with their own effects.
